blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and September 2026, detached houses: listings fell from 53 in June to 43 in September (−18.9%), and it took 21.5% of the city’s 298 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings fell from 63 in June to 55 in September (−12.7%), and it took 11.1% of the city’s 558 sales over the period.
The monthly write-ups singled out Walnut Grove for detached houses in June, July, August, September (a sellers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in June, July, August (a sellers’ best bet).

items.t: Community plan: the Walnut Grove Community Plan is Bylaw 1978 No. 1836, adopted by Council on November 26, 1979.

Walnut Grove's 30% detached ratio is the highest published detached ratio in the Langley community that month, ahead of Salmon River 23% and Murrayville 17%. SnapStats publishes medians at community level only, so a Walnut Grove-specific median is UNVERIFIED. Langley community context only (NOT Walnut Grove figures): Detached 449 / 64 / median $1,345,000; Condos & Townhomes 699 / 128 / median $611,000.

Recreation and health: Walnut Grove Community Centre is at 8889 Walnut Grove Drive, Langley Twp, a Township community / recreation centre; the guide page describes a 50 m pool with waterslide, diving boards and dive tower, a leisure pool, a fitness centre, gymnasium, preschool and the Walnut Grove library branch. Langley Memorial Hospital, 22051 Fraser Highway, is the Fraser Health community hospital serving Walnut Grove (24/7 emergency).

items.t: Township plans and zoning: Walnut Grove sits under the Township of Langley Zoning Bylaw No. 2500 and the Walnut Grove Community Plan, Bylaw 1978 No. 1836 (adopted November 26, 1979; now Schedule 6 to the Township OCP Bylaw 6200, adopted December 1, 2025, per the guide page).

Pad rent (parks): where a Walnut Grove purchase is a park home (the tenure the Forest Green Estates listings suggest), pad rent is governed by the Manufactured Home Park Tenancy Act, not the Strata Property Act: the rent increase limit for manufactured home site tenancies is 2.3% plus a proportional amount for 2026 and 2.2% plus a proportional amount for 2027, with 3 full months' notice and one increase per 12 months.

blocks.text: Good to know about Walnut Grove Guide

items.t: Any defect claim for this page would be UNVERIFIED on the current record.

Walnut Grove's guide feed hides its condo stock. The feed's only card in the source-audit re-read was a held park unit at Forest Green Estates (9080 198 Street) — neither of the two verified apartment buildings (both on 202 Street) surfaced in the card read.

The two real apartment buildings are neighbours, and the park is not a third. The Grove (8929 202 St, 2008) and The Hawthorne (8915 202 St, 2009) stand on the same 202 Street corridor built a year apart; Forest Green Estates, the name the feed surfaces, is a held manufactured-home community on 198 Street — three "Walnut Grove condo" search results, two strata buildings and one tenure trap. entries.

The 55+ shelf here is townhouses, not apartments. Twin Lakes (20655 88 Ave, 73 townhomes, 1993) and Spencer Green (21138 88 Ave, 97 duplex-style townhomes, 1991, by Polygon) are both published as 55+ Freehold Strata townhome communities — a downsizer comparing them against The Grove or The Hawthorne is comparing townhouse strata against apartment strata, with different Form B packages and different depreciation profiles.
One name, two directory entries, opposite tenures.
Detached tempo led Langley while attached moved mid-pack.

The plan predates the buildings by three decades. The Walnut Grove Community Plan (Bylaw 1836, adopted November 26, 1979) frames a community whose verified apartment stock was built in 2008–2009 — and the plan now sits as Schedule 6 to the 2025 OCP Update (Bylaw 6200), so a plan citation without the schedule history is incomplete for a Walnut Grove lot.

items.t: Fee-simple lots — the default form: Walnut Grove's documented housing form is established detached and attached housing under the Walnut Grove Community Plan (Bylaw 1978 No. 1836); the guide page's buyer cards cover detached/established homes, townhomes/strata, and homes near ravines (streamside setbacks). Twin Lakes 55+ disagreement — carried both ways, resolved nowhere: Both positions are carried here exactly; neither is adopted.

Forest Green Estates (9080 198 St) — UNCONFIRMED, listing-supported candidate only: the guide feed's one card in the re-read was a home in Forest Green Estates described in its listing text as a 55+ community.

Assemblies / proposals, documented AS SUCH, never as inventory: the Township's OCP update is revising community plans including the Walnut Grove Community Plan — a plan-revision process for parcels, not a subdivision, not serviced lots and not for-sale stock.

faq.a: Walnut Grove is a planned community and FVREB sub-area in the Township of Langley (not the City of Langley), north of Highway 1 across from Willoughby Heights, with its own Township community plan — Bylaw 1978 No. 1836, adopted November 26, 1979

faq.q: What recreation is in Walnut Grove?
faq.a: Walnut Grove Community Centre, the Township's community / recreation centre at 8889 Walnut Grove Drive, Langley Twp

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Walnut Grove than in June?
faq.a: In Walnut Grove, listings of houses fell from 53 in June to 43 in September (−18.9%); condos and townhomes fell from 63 in June to 55 in September (−12.7%).

faq.q: How big is Walnut Grove compared with the rest of Langley?
faq.a: In September 2026, Walnut Grove held 9.6% of the 449 houses listed in Langley and 7.9% of the 699 condos and townhomes listed in Langley.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Walnut Grove from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 64 houses and 62 condos and townhomes sold in Walnut Grove over those 4 months.

faq.q: How many apartment-condo buildings does Walnut Grove actually have?
faq.a: Everything else named in is townhouse-form or held.

faq.q: Is Forest Green Estates a condo?
faq.a: It is held UNCONFIRMED: the guide feed's only card and other listings describe manufactured homes in a 55+ community at 9080 198 Street — listing support only, no directory/strata/developer verification as condo stock. If the tenure is pad-rental, the purchase is governed by the Manufactured Home Park Tenancy Act, not the Strata Property Act — confirm tenure on title before anything else.

faq.q: How did Walnut Grove sell in September 2026?
faq.a: No Walnut Grove-specific median is published; the community medians (detached $1,345,000; attached $611,000) are whole-Langley figures, not Walnut Grove's.

faq.q: The directory says rentals are not allowed at Twin Lakes — can I rent a unit there?
faq.a: Long-term, yes — rental-restriction bylaws have been void province-wide since November 24, 2022, whatever the directory or older bylaw text says. Twin Lakes is directory-recorded with age restrictions and pets allowed with restrictions, which can still bind, and it is townhouse-form. Confirm the current registered bylaws on the Form B.

faq.q: Are The Grove and The Hawthorne age-restricted?
faq.a: The area's published 55+ product is the townhome shelf (Twin Lakes, Spencer Green), not the two apartment buildings.

faq.q: Is Forest Green Estates a townhome complex — or a condo?
faq.a: It is held UNCONFIRMED: the guide feed's only card and other listings describe manufactured homes in a 55+ community at 9080 198 Street — listing support only, no directory/strata/developer verification as strata stock.

faq.q: Is Walnut Grove in Langley City?
faq.a: No — it is a Township of Langley community, north of Highway 1.

faq.q: How many units can an eligible Walnut Grove lot hold under SSMUH?
faq.a: 3 units at 280 m² or smaller, 4 units between 280 m² and 4,050 m², if the lot is inside the Urban Containment Boundary, on municipal water and sewer, not heritage-designated and not in a Transit-Oriented Area.
